scope: Workflow and selected product-label references. This is not comprehensive interaction data, patient-specific clinical advice, or an endorsement by the cited organizations.

cards.title: MATCH medication reconciliation
cards.excerpt: Compare home and discharge medicine lists and seek prescriber clarification for unexplained differences. A blanket request to resume home medicines does not replace reconciliation.
cards.use: Source comparison and clarification workflow; does not authorize a dose or establish document authority.

cards.title: Re-Engineered Discharge, Tool 3
cards.excerpt: A discharge plan should identify pending tests and specify who will review results and how the patient will receive them.
cards.use: Prompt for missing follow-up ownership; does not interpret a test result or invent an appointment.

cards.title: Health Literacy Universal Precautions, Teach-Back
cards.excerpt: Ask the patient or caregiver to explain the plan in their own words. Clarify misunderstandings and check again instead of relying on a yes-or-no understanding question.
cards.use: Bounded questions to discuss with the care team; an automated prompt does not measure comprehension.

cards.title: Medication safety in transitions of care
cards.excerpt: Transitions of care and polypharmacy require reliable medication information, structured processes, patient and family participation, and measurement.
cards.use: Workflow rationale; does not validate this prototype or an autonomous prescribing algorithm.

cards.title: FHIR R4 Dosage
cards.excerpt: Dosage represents sequence, timing, route, amount and additional instructions separately. Retaining those distinctions matters for staged or conditional source instructions.
cards.use: Data-model inspiration only; the dossier is not a general FHIR importer.

cards.title: RxNorm terminology and lookup semantics
cards.excerpt: Terminology lookup identifies candidate medicine concepts. Ingredient identity alone does not establish equivalence of strength, release form, route or schedule.
cards.use: Pinned ingredient-identity references only. Unknown or ambiguous products require clarification, not automatic substitution.

cards.title: RxNav interaction service availability
cards.excerpt: RxNav discontinued its drug-drug interaction features on January 2, 2024. An unavailable dataset must not be interpreted as absence of interactions.
cards.use: Availability limitation; RxNorm is not a comprehensive interaction checker.

cards.title: Warfarin sodium label: bleeding-risk medicines
cards.excerpt: This label lists nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory medicines, including ibuprofen and naproxen, among medicines that can increase bleeding risk with warfarin.
cards.use: Selected label-backed review flag only. Confirm which medicines are current with the care team; do not independently stop or change a medicine.

cards.title: Eliquis label: anticoagulants and antiplatelet agents
cards.excerpt: This label describes increased bleeding risk when apixaban is combined with chronic NSAID use or other medicines affecting hemostasis.
cards.use: Selected label-backed review flag only. It does not establish a contraindication in this invented case or authorize changing anticoagulation.

cards.title: openFDA data limitations
cards.excerpt: openFDA is public reference data, not a patient-specific medical decision engine. Its documentation warns against relying on it for medical-care decisions.
cards.use: No comprehensive interaction sensitivity or zero-hallucination guarantee is inferred from API access.
